name: Ahmad Kamruzzaman
title: Junior Software Developer
bio: Detail-oriented software developer with hands-on experience building and deploying web applications using React, JavaScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. Bridging EEE insights with clean, scalable full-stack software.
aboutMe:
I am a detail-oriented Junior Software Developer and B.Sc. candidate in Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE) at North South University (expected in 2026). With hands-on experience building and deploying web applications using React, JavaScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, I specialize in full-stack web development, custom API architectures, and robust database setups.

My dual background in EEE and software development provides a strong analytical foundation for solving complex technical problems at the intersection of logical software and physical hardware. From engineering Content Management Systems and building real-time inventory management dashboards with analytical charting, to automating continuous delivery pipelines (CI/CD) on Vercel, I strive for clean architecture and structural elegance. I am teachable, interactive, and driven to solve real-world industrial challenges through rigorous software design.
